title: Benchmark Evaluation of Electronic Image Stabilization and De-rotation Gating in Monocular Visual Odometry
description: This repository provides a simulation-based benchmark evaluation of electronic image stabilization (EIS) and yaw-rate de-rotation gating in monocular visual odometry. Across 24 core matrix flight comparisons (n=3), EIS-GATED did not significantly improve trajectory accuracy over RAW, while a recoverPose depth-filter configuration failure under small baselines was identified and repaired. Code MIT; data, figures and documents CC BY 4.0
